result.topic_en: Despite the stated notebook context, this page holds German history notes, not mathematics: the religious consequences of the division of Israel, the rise of the prophets, the idea of the Messiah, and the start of a section on the history of the Kingdom of Israel (975–722 BC).

früher unter den Juden war, aber jetzt erst an-
fing recht lebendig zu werden, die Idee des Messias.
